scenario: Worker grants execution under shared lock and calls execute_turn outside lock
Another caller observes explicit revocation or writer failure and clears visibility; a future independent deadline watcher would require its own seam.
Native callback finishes with a complete available operation
Faithful physical order records terminal Fence before native Executed completion
current_constraints: owner.rs759-764 separates execution grant from callback by releasing shared lock; revoke/status may run concurrently.
causal_owner_history.rs589 rejects Executed after terminal; Fence819 sets terminal.
Simply removing terminal rejection is insufficient: assignment684 would clear terminal on a later successful completion.
Docs causal_owner_history.md51-53 require a late complete operation remain evidence and be withheld.

recommended_contract: Before runtime migration add a typed ExecutionPermitted/ExecutionStarted observation naming exact input and unique execution token/reserved native ordinal. Define it as the linearized authorization/entry boundary, not proof of first adapter mutation or callback completion.

Serialize permit and concurrent fences through the same ordered owner sequencer/lock transition; do not hold the lock across adapter execution or filesystem waits. Immediate safety revocation remains independent of journal admission/durability.
Permit only earliest eligible input before terminal, with one in-flight token and no active prior completed release. Check source/generation/state/budgets at the appropriate entry boundary.

After terminal accept only the matching already-permitted complete operation as evidence. Validate exact input/token/native ordinal/generation/state linkage and preserve terminal with monotonic OR. No new execution permit, release intent, handoff, snapshot availability or successor execution is allowed.

Matching complete operation must be retained and attempted for bounded durable finalization when the journal remains writable, then Withheld. A visibility deadline must not silently erase complete evidence or grant new execution.

A proved CaptureSession preflight rejection may explicitly close a permit as not invoked without native ordinal advance; do not use generic terminal NotExecuted for a callback that may have mutated. Panic/incomplete/uncertain failure remains ExecutionUnknown.

If the original writer is failed/closed and cannot durably accept either fence or completion, retain honest prefix uncertainty and typed local failure/indeterminate settlement. Do not claim those observations persisted, seal the prefix as complete, invent a successful fallback or resume the mutated engine.
A permit-only crash remains execution-unknown: a permit does not prove callback invocation. A late completed record is evidence even when success cannot be handed off.
Keep observation timestamp distinct from durable ACK time; do not serialize a fabricated own post-barrier acknowledgement time into bytes prepared before the barrier.
Negotiate added event semantics explicitly before runtime activation; existing readers must reject unsupported variants rather than silently treating them as old MFCJ2 semantics.
required_tests: Deterministic barrier-controlled actual SessionMachine: callback enters and blocks; revoke concurrently; unblock, preserve full native operation and ordered Fence-before-completion; no outputs/snapshot/new execution.
Fence before execution permit: no callback, no native ordinal increment; later permit/Executed refused without changing prefix.

Permit before fence but callback not yet invoked: explicit permit semantics, then either proved preflight/not-invoked settlement or matching withheld completion; never assert actual mutation from permit alone.
Equivalent source/deadline/writer observation races with callback completion and already-admitted late ACK; original ticket settles, no release revival.

Wrong/duplicate execution token, skipped earlier input, wrong source/generation/state, second in-flight permit, successor after terminal, ReleaseIntent/HandoffObserved after terminal all refuse without prefix mutation.
Crash prefixes after ingress, permit, fence, completed native operation and withheld settlement retain distinct honest uncertainties; no released QueueDrain items.
Writer failure prevents additional durable evidence: actual raw prefix and typed local settlement agree; no claimed durable fence/completion or retry execution.
Recording count/byte retention and retirement tested separately across permit, late completion and withholding; no double release or unbounded finalization backlog.
qualification_limits: This review does not invalidate prior passed source tests or reopen source06 closure findings; those tests cover implemented validator semantics.
